text: Chapter 2 contains no load-bearing prose passages — its 11 pages are entirely book front matter (Benson and Peter Farrell's introductions, Farrell's biographical sketch, the QUOTES blurb section from Andy LaVerne, Adam Rogers, Toninho Horta, Lula Galvão and others, plus acknowledgements to Filipe Faria, Bill Moio, and Farrell's family and teachers). No techniques, scales, or examples are introduced. Despite the TOC heading 'D7(9) Giant Lines,' the actual harmonic content begins in later chapters.
